steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Blaze. I need you to lead the team to seize the advantage.)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (You want to organize a raid?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I'm very worried about our current situation.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Both we and the Yetis have used our respective skills to locate the Doctor and FrostNova. Thanks to your Arts, they are now safe.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (And... The two are very close. If you can save one, you can save the other.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (There are two things we can't be sure of right now.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (First, who will reach them first...?)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Second, FrostNova's attitude.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Exactly.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (If we get the initiative, we'll have to subdue FrostNova immediately. But we also have to trade her for Yeti Squad's cooperation.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (That way, we avoid fighting, and also deepen the opportunity for communication.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (But if they get there first...)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um, Amiya, the heartbeat detector found something. We have a position, but we don't know the depth...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey... Wait!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Where's the fire? Aww.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: As soon as the Doctor comes up, she gets all panicky and forgets herself.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I'm not sure if this is a bug in Amiya or a feature...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You know, the stuff she just said, that's not like her at all. She came up with it too fast.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: At least she didn't come around to a sneak attack. This one's on us.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Not quite. If we ambushed them, the Yetis would just fight to the death.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm here to rescue you all, not cause more casualties. She didn't give up on her winning outcome.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...I guess I should apologize. It's the mercenary in me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You didn't do it, did you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Keeping a level head after her victories and keeping to her tactical goals are what makes me trust Amiya as field commander.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm gonna go check on the Yetis.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: This structure... It's so complicated. It makes my head hurt.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Describe it to me and I'll draw it up.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Huh? I didn't even finish my eighth grade textbook in middle school. Give me a break.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: What did you do instead of class again?

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: I went to train.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Why not let Nesti try? He's got some Arts, doesn't he?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: He's all about reciting poetry and writing essays. That's not your structural probing business.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Well, why not try to express it through numbers?

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Good idea. I'm okay at math. Let's try it.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Does it feel hot to you?

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: No. I'm wearing this thick heavy thing and even so I still feel Sister's Originium freezing my skin off...

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Hi, Rhodes Island cat.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry, but when I sweat, the air around me heats up, and then I just keep sweating.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Thanks to you guys, I'm feeling a lot cooler than usual.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Are you nervous?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: A little. I never thought I'd be working with the enemy.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: For now, at least, we aren't enemies. After digging out our Sister, we'll do what she says. But we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...You guys really aren't anything like the other Reunion folks.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: You think the rest of Reunion is all the same? Are you and the bunny the same?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, yeah. Good point. We've got all kinds on our side.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Everyone's got all kinds.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: At least you're willing to listen to us. The Ursus soldiers all just shoot us on sight.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: The arrows start flying and they don't stop until one side is dead.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Good thing we're a pharmaceutical company and not a bunch of Ursus soldiers.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Do pharmaceutical companies all have equipment like yours?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The world is a dangerous place and we have to protect ourselves, right?

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: It would be nice if you spent your time farming instead of battling.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: If you can grow a harvest of red wheat, you'll feed half a town's starving Infected.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: If they weren't starving, they wouldn't have gone into that little town. Then they wouldn't have been shot.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: If only.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Enough of that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: He's pretty sentimental. You know, I think all Ursus are pretty sentimental.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: No slacking off!

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Oops, sorry. Time to get back to work.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No big deal. Go back to your work.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But that thing you're carrying, it's got a powerful smell.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Oh? This...? I...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: What's she talking about?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Nothing. Don't worry.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, a mite peckish.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: What are you looking at me for?
Ruins of Chernobog 'District 14'
Sector Surface
3 hours into the excavation operation

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Amiya, stop!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Your fingers are bleeding! Stop digging with your hands!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I can feel something down there... Right down here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't feel it if I'm using a tool... I have to use my fingers to pick up on that tiny whisper of a feeling...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's close!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Meteorite...)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Leave her be.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we let them get there first...

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: It's okay, you can do it!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: Use Arts! I- I can't. I really can't!

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: We can do this even without our Sister, right? Hurry up and make the temperatures nice and different. The bigger the difference, the better!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: I'll try... But don't blame me if it doesn't work!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Who else can we blame besides you...?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member C
steps.text: Don't tease him. He has to concentrate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Here! Right here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...A wall? Did I get it wrong?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just smash it! Break through...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But if it collapses, I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... got it wrong.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: It's open!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze! Meteorite!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Get ready.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Said I won't lose.

options: You didn't give me a winning choice.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Sister!

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: This is the one they call the Doctor.

options: So am I being shot or hanged?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The leader of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's me. You can call me Amiya.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Her rings... are turning red?)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Aren't you going to stop her?)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Why would I stop our only chance at winning?)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I respect Amiya's decision.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Nesti, is Rhodes Island not fighting you?

steps.name: Nesti
steps.text: They're not.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Then here on this battlefield, we are not enemies.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: There is no reason to fight if we are not enemies.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go back, Doctor, to your people.

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: ...Our Sister is so magnanimous.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Like she needs your approval.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Quiet down.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Little rabbit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Uh, my name is Amiya...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You're going to Lungmen too, aren't you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...That's right.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Then we will be enemies before long, little rabbit. Just, not yet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova, you and your team aren't as destructive as the other Reunion units.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't blame my people. You don't know what they've been through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you don't want them to go on like this!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It seems you can read my mind?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't. But I do sense your unease and your consternation.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: All of this will be swept away after the fall of Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island, we can honestly understand you and your squad.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You may think I'm wrong, and that we don't understand you at all...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But FrostNova, ma'am, I know exactly what you've been through.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ......Childish.

options: FrostNova, those clothes aren't yours, are they?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They're not. This was once the cloak of the 'Patriot.' I wove it into a coat.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: How can you tell?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Never mind...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Everyone has some things they can't say, I suppose.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova, Rhodes Island does not seek out conflict. We want to avoid unnecessary bloodshed.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And which bloodshed was necessary?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At the very least, we don't want to fight your squad!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They are all good, decent people. We absolutely cannot hurt them, or let them hurt innocent people!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Then you must pray we do not meet again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I think I don't much want to hurt you either. But if I have to, I will kill you all.

options: You can come to Rhodes Island. We don't have to fight.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Then you can try to beat me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Defeat me in battle, and I will consider it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But of course, once we meet on the battlefield, we are enemies. And as enemies, we will fight to the death.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Oh yes. This one, for the fox.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: A special remedy for frostbite. One-of-a-kind recipe. It relieves the burning and pain.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I've studied these things for a long time. And you fought very well back there.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Warriors willing to sacrifice themselves are the strongest, in my eyes.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, wait. I have something to say too.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeti #1!

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Oh... huh?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What's happening?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Let's get a drink next time! Your vodka smells great!

steps.name: Yeti #1
steps.text: Don't say that out loud!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Goodbye, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I hope we never meet again.
Lungmen Substructure

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Here you are, after all.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hello, Rhodes Island.
